user.title: Connect to a Rockwell PLC
user.description: Logix: enter the IP, adding /slot if the CPU isn't in slot 0 (e.g. 192.168.1.10/2) or a full route path. SLC/MicroLogix: enter the IP. {error}

options.title: Polling, writes and tags
options.description: Writes are off by default. Switch, number and button tags are created as read-only sensors (or skipped, for buttons) until 'Allow writes' is on. {error}

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the PLC.
error.invalid_tags: The tag list is invalid. See the message above.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.
